desc: Python 3.13 (CPython, stdlib included) sandbox: run a program with stdin and argv, read its stdout.
usage: POST /v1/run {"svc":"cxpy","code":"print(1+1)"} or op py{code,stdin}. Pure-Python stdlib, no pip, no network, no threads; sys.argv[0]="<code>"; /lib of the job fs is first on sys.path. Uncaught exception: traceback on stdout, exit 1; sys.exit(n) exits n. Deterministic time, hash seed 0.
out: program stdout (uncaught exception: traceback on stdout, exit 1)

{"code":"import json
obj = {'name': 'cx', 'n': 3, 'ok': True, 'none': None, 'list': [1, 'two', 3.5], 'nested': {'a': [{'b': 1}]}}
s = json.dumps(obj)
print(s)
back = json.loads(s)
print(back['nested']['a'][0]['b'], len(back['list']), ','.join(back), json.dumps(back) == s, json.dumps({'z': 1, 'a': 2}, sort_keys=True))

{"code":"import re
text = 'Contact: ada@example.com, linus@kernel.org; phone +44 20 7946 0958.'
print(re.findall(r'[\w.]+@[\w.]+\.\w+', text), bool(re.fullmatch(r'\d{3}-\d{4}', '555-0100')), text.find('phone'))
m = re.search(r'(\+\d+) (\d+) (\d+) (\d+)', text)
print(m.group(0), m.start(), '|'.join(m.groups()), bool(re.search(r'colou?r', 'COLOR', re.I)))
"}
